$comment: Kastor issue forms, label policy, and source drift checks.

fields.label: Goal
fields.help: What should be true when this task is finished? One or two sentences.

fields.label: Done when
fields.help: A checklist. Each item must be something you can check.
fields.default:
- [ ]
- [ ] Tests added or updated (if the change has behavior)
- [ ] Documents updated (README / ADR / requirements / architecture / CHANGELOG)

fields.label: Question
fields.help: One specific question. "How does NLDM table lookup work?" is good. "Learn STA" is too big.

fields.label: Time box
fields.help: The most time you will spend before you stop and write down what you know.

fields.label: Planned public sources
fields.help: Papers, textbooks, documentation of open-source tools. Public sources only.

fields.label: Expected output
fields.default:
- [ ] Research note in `docs/research/`
- [ ] Worked example with real numbers (if it applies)
- [ ] ADR or requirement updated (if a decision follows)

fields.label: What happened
fields.help: What did you do, what did you expect, what did you get?

fields.label: How to reproduce
fields.help: Exact commands and input files. A small input is best.

fields.label: Environment
fields.help: OS, compiler and version, CMake version, build type.

fields.label: Done when
fields.help: Observable acceptance criteria for reviewing this Epic.
